creation.prompt: Edit reference 1, the owner-selected paired Leo+Milo transparent performance. S06-L002-B01-I03: Leo remains lying with head/chest raised as reference 1. His NEAR FRONT paw is extended and planted on the ground immediately beside/in front of Milo to block the path. It is a front limb, never the rear paw used for the S05 trip. Show a continuous anatomically attached foreleg from shoulder through rounded wrist to large clawless paw. Milo stays screen-RIGHT at the path-arrival body scale/position and looks startled toward Leo. The paw blocks his route with clear space beside his body; never touch, cover, step on, trap or grab Milo. Preserve rear legs/tail/trunk and Milo silhouette. This planted front-paw layout becomes the base for later frozen/worried/humbled face-only variants. Canonical references 2/4 own Milo identity and his own visible surface ratios; 3/5 own Leo identity and his DIFFERENT species-specific ratios. Do not independently resize heads, torsos, ears, paws or characters; preserve same-depth relative design from selected pair. Milo stays lean grey felt with grey felt paws, cream muzzle/belly, moss-green eyes, orange tail, readable neck and continuous hips/legs. Canonical upright head fraction 0.39 +/-0.01 applies only at compatible upright pitch, not to bent/lying poses. Keep Leo canonical mane/skull/ears/trunk and rounded paws. Both mouths closed, toothless; narrator never creates speech shapes. Full pair with margins, genuine transparent alpha. No background, ground plane, cast shadow, props, annotation marks, words or watermark. One output only.
